commands:
set -euo pipefail
TEST_DIR=$(mktemp -d /tmp/vast-dashboard-tests.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$TEST_DIR"' EXIT
ARCHIVE=prometheus-3.13.1.linux-amd64.tar.gz
curl --fail --location --retry 3 \
  "https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/releases/download/v3.13.1/$ARCHIVE" \
  --output "$TEST_DIR/$ARCHIVE"
printf '%s  %s\n' \
  962b812371aff838d152b6ff2d56fdb7a6396f5542f48ebf73421b9721f0d103 \
  "$TEST_DIR/$ARCHIVE" | sha256sum --check -
tar -xzf "$TEST_DIR/$ARCHIVE" -C "$TEST_DIR" \
  prometheus-3.13.1.linux-amd64/promtool \
  prometheus-3.13.1.linux-amd64/prometheus
export PATH="$TEST_DIR/prometheus-3.13.1.linux-amd64:$PATH"
promtool --version
python3 -m venv "$TEST_DIR/venv"
"$TEST_DIR/venv/bin/pip" install --disable-pip-version-check pytest pyyaml
"$TEST_DIR/venv/bin/python" -m pytest -q \
  tests/test_vast_dashboard_registration.py \
  tests/test_vast_income_dashboard.py \
  tests/test_vast_occupancy_dashboard.py \
  tests/test_vast_snapshot_panels.py \
  tests/test_power_recording_rules.py \
  tests/test_vastai_exporter_metrics.py
python scripts/image_promotion.py tags --image ghcr.io/cryptolabsza/dc-overview
IFS=',' read -ra TAG_ARRAY <<< "${{ steps.tags.outputs.tags }}"
TAG_ARGS=""
for tag in "${TAG_ARRAY[@]}"; do
  TAG_ARGS="$TAG_ARGS -t $tag"
done

docker build --platform linux/amd64 \
  --label org.opencontainers.image.revision="$GITHUB_SHA" \
  --label org.opencontainers.image.version="${{ steps.tags.outputs.version }}" \
  $TAG_ARGS \
  --build-arg GIT_COMMIT=${{ github.sha }} \
  --build-arg GIT_BRANCH=${{ github.ref_name }} \
  --build-arg BUILD_TIME="$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC')" \
  .

TEST_VENV=$(mktemp -d /tmp/runpod-exporter-tests.XXXXXX)
cleanup() {
  rm -rf "$TEST_VENV"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
python3 -m venv "$TEST_VENV"
"$TEST_VENV/bin/pip" install --disable-pip-version-check pytest
"$TEST_VENV/bin/python" -m pytest -q \
  tests/test_runpod_health_state.py \
  tests/test_runpod_exporter_health.py \
  tests/test_runpod_alerts.py
python scripts/image_promotion.py tags --image ghcr.io/cryptolabsza/runpod-exporter
IFS=',' read -ra TAG_ARRAY <<< "${{ steps.tags.outputs.tags }}"
TAG_ARGS=""
for tag in "${TAG_ARRAY[@]}"; do
  TAG_ARGS="$TAG_ARGS -t $tag"
done

docker build --platform linux/amd64 \
  --label org.opencontainers.image.revision="$GITHUB_SHA" \
  --label org.opencontainers.image.version="${{ steps.tags.outputs.version }}" \
  $TAG_ARGS \
  --build-arg GIT_COMMIT=${{ github.sha }} \
  --build-arg GIT_BRANCH=${{ github.ref_name }} \
  --build-arg BUILD_TIME="$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC')" \
  ./runpod-exporter
PRIMARY_TAG="${{ steps.tags.outputs.tags }}"
PRIMARY_TAG="${PRIMARY_TAG%%,*}"
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint python3 "$PRIMARY_TAG" -c '
import runpod_exporter
from health_state import HealthState

metrics = HealthState(path=None).format_metrics(["contract-check"])
required = (
    "runpod_health_state_schema_version 1",
    "runpod_health_state_persist_success 1",
    "runpod_api_poll_success{account=\"contract-check\"} 0",
    "# HELP runpod_machine_health_known",
    "# HELP runpod_machine_present",
    "# HELP runpod_machine_health_listed",
)
missing = [metric for metric in required if metric not in metrics]
assert not missing, f"RunPod health contract missing: {missing}"
'

IFS=',' read -ra TAG_ARRAY <<< "${{ steps.tags.outputs.tags }}"
TAG_ARGS=""
for tag in "${TAG_ARRAY[@]}"; do
  TAG_ARGS="$TAG_ARGS -t $tag"
done

docker build --platform linux/amd64 \
  --label org.opencontainers.image.revision="$GITHUB_SHA" \
  --label org.opencontainers.image.version="${{ steps.tags.outputs.version }}" \
  $TAG_ARGS \
  --build-arg GIT_COMMIT=${{ github.sha }} \
  --build-arg GIT_BRANCH=${{ github.ref_name }} \
  --build-arg BUILD_TIME="$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC')" \
  ./vastai-exporter

release_job_dir=$(mktemp -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/python-release-build.XXXXXX")
printf 'RELEASE_JOB_DIR=%s\n' "$release_job_dir" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
python -m pip install build
mkdir "$RELEASE_JOB_DIR/release-source" "$RELEASE_JOB_DIR/release-dist"
git archive HEAD | tar -x -C "$RELEASE_JOB_DIR/release-source"
GIT_DIR="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.git" GIT_WORK_TREE="$RELEASE_JOB_DIR/release-source" GITHUB_REF_NAME="$RELEASE_TAG" \
  python -m build "$RELEASE_JOB_DIR/release-source" --outdir "$RELEASE_JOB_DIR/release-dist"

printf 'DOCKER_CONFIG=%s/docker-config-build-%s-%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
set -euo pipefail
TEST_DIR=$(mktemp -d /tmp/vast-dashboard-tests.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$TEST_DIR"' EXIT
ARCHIVE=prometheus-3.13.1.linux-amd64.tar.gz
curl --fail --location --retry 3 \
  "https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/releases/download/v3.13.1/$ARCHIVE" \
  --output "$TEST_DIR/$ARCHIVE"
printf '%s  %s\n' \
  962b812371aff838d152b6ff2d56fdb7a6396f5542f48ebf73421b9721f0d103 \
  "$TEST_DIR/$ARCHIVE" | sha256sum --check -
tar -xzf "$TEST_DIR/$ARCHIVE" -C "$TEST_DIR" \
  prometheus-3.13.1.linux-amd64/promtool \
  prometheus-3.13.1.linux-amd64/prometheus
export PATH="$TEST_DIR/prometheus-3.13.1.linux-amd64:$PATH"
promtool --version
python3 -m venv "$TEST_DIR/venv"
"$TEST_DIR/venv/bin/pip" install --disable-pip-version-check pytest pyyaml
"$TEST_DIR/venv/bin/python" -m pytest -q \
  tests/test_vast_dashboard_registration.py \
  tests/test_vast_income_dashboard.py \
  tests/test_vast_occupancy_dashboard.py \
  tests/test_vast_snapshot_panels.py \
  tests/test_power_recording_rules.py \
  tests/test_vastai_exporter_metrics.py
python scripts/image_promotion.py tags --image ghcr.io/cryptolabsza/dc-overview
IFS=',' read -ra TAG_ARRAY <<< "${{ steps.tags.outputs.tags }}"
TAG_ARGS=""
for tag in "${TAG_ARRAY[@]}"; do
  TAG_ARGS="$TAG_ARGS -t $tag"
done

docker build --platform linux/amd64 \
  --label org.opencontainers.image.revision="$GITHUB_SHA" \
  --label org.opencontainers.image.version="${{ steps.tags.outputs.version }}" \
  $TAG_ARGS \
  --build-arg GIT_COMMIT=${{ github.sha }} \
  --build-arg GIT_BRANCH=${{ github.ref_name }} \
  --build-arg BUILD_TIME="$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC')" \
  .
IFS=',' read -ra TAG_ARRAY <<< "${{ steps.tags.outputs.tags }}"
for tag in "${TAG_ARRAY[@]}"; do
  echo "Pushing $tag..."
  docker --config "$DOCKER_CONFIG" push "$tag"
done
docker --config "$DOCKER_CONFIG" logout ${{ env.REGISTRY }} 2>/dev/null || true
rm -rf "$DOCKER_CONFIG"
echo "## Docker image workflow result" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "**Channel:** ${{ steps.tags.outputs.channel }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "**Version:** ${{ steps.tags.outputs.version }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "**Preflight:** ${{ needs.release-preflight.outputs.status }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "**Commit:** ${{ github.sha }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "**Platform:** linux/amd64" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "### Requested identity tags:" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "${{ steps.tags.outputs.tags }}" | tr ',' '\n' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

printf 'DOCKER_CONFIG=%s/docker-config-runpod-%s-%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
TEST_VENV=$(mktemp -d /tmp/runpod-exporter-tests.XXXXXX)
cleanup() {
  rm -rf "$TEST_VENV"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
python3 -m venv "$TEST_VENV"
"$TEST_VENV/bin/pip" install --disable-pip-version-check pytest
"$TEST_VENV/bin/python" -m pytest -q \
  tests/test_runpod_health_state.py \
  tests/test_runpod_exporter_health.py \
  tests/test_runpod_alerts.py
python scripts/image_promotion.py tags --image ghcr.io/cryptolabsza/runpod-exporter
IFS=',' read -ra TAG_ARRAY <<< "${{ steps.tags.outputs.tags }}"
TAG_ARGS=""
for tag in "${TAG_ARRAY[@]}"; do
  TAG_ARGS="$TAG_ARGS -t $tag"
done

docker build --platform linux/amd64 \
  --label org.opencontainers.image.revision="$GITHUB_SHA" \
  --label org.opencontainers.image.version="${{ steps.tags.outputs.version }}" \
  $TAG_ARGS \
  --build-arg GIT_COMMIT=${{ github.sha }} \
  --build-arg GIT_BRANCH=${{ github.ref_name }} \
  --build-arg BUILD_TIME="$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC')" \
  ./runpod-exporter
PRIMARY_TAG="${{ steps.tags.outputs.tags }}"
PRIMARY_TAG="${PRIMARY_TAG%%,*}"
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint python3 "$PRIMARY_TAG" -c '
import runpod_exporter
from health_state import HealthState

metrics = HealthState(path=None).format_metrics(["contract-check"])
required = (
    "runpod_health_state_schema_version 1",
    "runpod_health_state_persist_success 1",
    "runpod_api_poll_success{account=\"contract-check\"} 0",
    "# HELP runpod_machine_health_known",
    "# HELP runpod_machine_present",
    "# HELP runpod_machine_health_listed",
)
missing = [metric for metric in required if metric not in metrics]
assert not missing, f"RunPod health contract missing: {missing}"
'
IFS=',' read -ra TAG_ARRAY <<< "${{ steps.tags.outputs.tags }}"
for tag in "${TAG_ARRAY[@]}"; do
  echo "Pushing $tag..."
  docker --config "$DOCKER_CONFIG" push "$tag"
done
docker --config "$DOCKER_CONFIG" logout ${{ env.REGISTRY }} 2>/dev/null || true
rm -rf "$DOCKER_CONFIG"
echo "## RunPod image workflow result" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "**Preflight:** ${{ needs.release-preflight.outputs.status }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "**Commit:** ${{ github.sha }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "### Requested identity tags:" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "${{ steps.tags.outputs.tags }}" | tr ',' '\n' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

printf 'DOCKER_CONFIG=%s/docker-config-vastai-%s-%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
python scripts/image_promotion.py tags --image ghcr.io/cryptolabsza/vastai-exporter
IFS=',' read -ra TAG_ARRAY <<< "${{ steps.tags.outputs.tags }}"
TAG_ARGS=""
for tag in "${TAG_ARRAY[@]}"; do
  TAG_ARGS="$TAG_ARGS -t $tag"
done

docker build --platform linux/amd64 \
  --label org.opencontainers.image.revision="$GITHUB_SHA" \
  --label org.opencontainers.image.version="${{ steps.tags.outputs.version }}" \
  $TAG_ARGS \
  --build-arg GIT_COMMIT=${{ github.sha }} \
  --build-arg GIT_BRANCH=${{ github.ref_name }} \
  --build-arg BUILD_TIME="$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC')" \
  ./vastai-exporter
IFS=',' read -ra TAG_ARRAY <<< "${{ steps.tags.outputs.tags }}"
for tag in "${TAG_ARRAY[@]}"; do
  echo "Pushing $tag..."
  docker --config "$DOCKER_CONFIG" push "$tag"
done
docker --config "$DOCKER_CONFIG" logout ${{ env.REGISTRY }} 2>/dev/null || true
rm -rf "$DOCKER_CONFIG"
echo "## Vast.ai image workflow result" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "**Preflight:** ${{ needs.release-preflight.outputs.status }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "**Commit:** ${{ github.sha }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "### Requested identity tags:" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo "${{ steps.tags.outputs.tags }}" | tr ',' '\n' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

mkdir "$RELEASE_JOB_DIR/release-source" "$RELEASE_JOB_DIR/release-dist"
git archive HEAD | tar -x -C "$RELEASE_JOB_DIR/release-source"
GIT_DIR="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.git" GIT_WORK_TREE="$RELEASE_JOB_DIR/release-source" GITHUB_REF_NAME="$RELEASE_TAG" \
  python -m build "$RELEASE_JOB_DIR/release-source" --outdir "$RELEASE_JOB_DIR/release-dist"

printf 'PROMOTION_DIR=%s/image-promotion-%s-%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
mkdir -p "$PROMOTION_DIR"
python scripts/image_promotion.py promote \
  --release-tag "$RELEASE_TAG" --source-sha "$SOURCE_SHA" \
  --expected-digest "dc-overview=$DC_OVERVIEW_DIGEST" \
  --expected-digest "runpod-exporter=$RUNPOD_EXPORTER_DIGEST" \
  --expected-digest "vastai-exporter=$VASTAI_EXPORTER_DIGEST" \
  --platform linux/amd64 \
  --receipt "$PROMOTION_DIR/promotion-receipt.json"
